description.subtitle: MC David quilted pirate compression collars - black
description.intro: Mc David 3/4 Guard 2.0 GK goalkeeper meshes combine a compression fit with strategically distributed protections to provide security, comfort and freedom of movement under sticks. Its construction is designed to protect the most exposed areas during stretching and falling, maintaining a light and flexible feel.
key_benefits: Protection in key areas: Padded padding helps cushion impacts on knees, thighs and hips during falls and stretches.
Greater durability: The double layer of fabric on the protections reinforces the areas subjected to greater wear.
Comfort during stress: The fabric promotes breathability and helps to manage moisture during workouts and matches.
Mobility without restrictions: Light and flexible construction accompanies the movements of the goalkeeper while maintaining a tight fit.

Movilidad sin restricciones: La construcción ligera y flexible acompaña los movimientos del portero manteniendo un ajuste ceñido.
